ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 251 Section G is an Honors section for MCB Honors students and James Scholars. All other interested students should contact Shawna Naidu at shawna@illinois.edu for information and approval. Laboratories begin on Monday, August 25, 2014. MCB 251 laboratory sections will not meet the week of September 1, 2014. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment. This course-based tuition is non-refundable after the 10th day of class.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to James Scholars Program students.
